identificationModule.briefTitle: Claudin18.2 CAR-T (CT041) in Patients With Gastric, Pancreatic Cancer, or Other Specified Digestive Cancers
identificationModule.officialTitle: Open-label, Multicenter, Phase 1b/2 Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Autologous Anti-claudin 18.2 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-cell Therapy in Subjects With Advanced Gastric, Pancreatic, or Other Specified Digestive System Cancers

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A Phase 1b/2, open label, multi-center, clinical study of Chimeric Antigen Receptor T Cells (CAR-T) targeting claudin18.2 in patients with advanced gastric, pancreatic or other specified digestive system cancers
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
This is an open label, multi-center, Phase 1b/2 clinical trial to evaluate the safety and efficacy of autologous claudin18.2 chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy in patients with advanced gastric, pancreatic or other specified digestive system cancers.

Following consent, patients must have tumor tissue evaluated by CLDN18.2 IHC assay. Patients meeting all eligibility criteria will undergo a leukapheresis procedure to collect autologous mononuclear cells for manufacture of investigational drug product (CT041). Following manufacture of the drug product, subjects will receive preconditioning prior to CT041 infusion. All subjects will be asked to continue to undergo long-term gene safety follow-up.

armGroups.label: anti-claudin18.2 chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy
armGroups.description: Phase 1b will include two parts, dose escalation phase (Cohort A) followed by a dose expansion phase (Cohort B). Phase 2 (Cohort C) will evaluate the chosen dose in patients with advanced gastric cancer.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1b (Cohort A): Evaluate the safety and tolerability of CAR-CLDN18.2 T-cell therapy (CT041) in subjects with specified advanced digestive system cancers (STAD, PAAD, or BTC).
primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence of adverse events (AEs), AEs of special interest (cytokine release syndrome \[CRS\], neurotoxicity, secondary malignancy), serious adverse events (SAEs).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1b (Cohort A): Identify the recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) of CT041 therapy in subjects with advanced STAD, PAAD, or BTC.
Phase 1b (Cohort A): Identify the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) or maximum administered dose (MAD) of CT041 therapy in subjects with STAD, PAAD, or BTC.
primaryOutcomes.description: The highest dose below the dose where the escalation was stopped when the frequency or severity of DLTs exceeds predefined safety criteria.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1b (Cohort B): Determine the efficacy of CT041 by ORR in subjects with advanced STAD, PAAD, or BTC.
primaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate by IRC assessment (RECIST v1.1)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 2 (Cohort C): Determine the efficacy of CT041 by ORR in subjects with advanced STAD treated at the RP2D.
primaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate by IRC assessment (RECIST v1.1)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1b/2: Objective Response Rate (ORR) per investigator assessment
secondaryOutcomes.description: Rate of subjects experiencing an objective response (a binary variable indicating whether each subject experienced a ≥ partial response \[PR\] by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors, version 1.1 \[RECIST 1.1\]), as determined by investigator assessment.
Duration of time from first response to progression of disease as determined by investigator
Duration of time in months from the date of CT041 infusion until disease progression, excluding deaths as determined by investigator.
The incidence of a BOR of CR, PR, or SD based on investigator assessments using RECIST 1.1 criteria.
The time in months from the date of CT041 infusion to the earliest date of disease progression or death due to any cause as determined by investigator.

The time in months from the date of CT041 infusion to the earlier date of disease progression or death due to any cause as determined by investigator and IRC assessment.
The time in months from the date of CT041 infusion until the date of death by any cause.

Total days of hospitalization, including ICU days, during \& after CT041 infusion as described below:

* Infusion-related hospital re-admission within 3 months after infusion.
* The number and percentages of subjects, and the number of hospitalizations due to non-infusion reasons.
* All-cause re-admission within 3 months after infusion, and from infusion to data cutoff date among those who required rehospitalization
* Duration of hospitalization in intensive care
